assessments.reasoning: Printed p.35 requires an expression with an assignment-compatible value, restricts the formal’s type to one eligible as a file component, and attributes the current value to the formal variable upon activation.

challenge.method: Read §6.6.3.2 and compare the immediately adjacent variable-parameter rule. Check whether the word assigned implies the physical parameter mechanism or an evaluation order.
challenge.results: The statement uses assigned in the abstract attribution sense. The language rule uses compatibility and current value. Earlier access, caller variable identity, calling convention and argument evaluation order remain outside the stated claim.

limitations: This is the language's parameter rule. It does not specify argument evaluation order, machine-level copying, or conformant-array parameter rules.
Exact unextended ISO/IEC 7185:1990 online replica. The replica gives the printed text precedence where they differ. ISO 10206 Extended Pascal and product dialects require separate evidence.
